subject.title: fix(diagnostics): derive heap thresholds from V8 heap size limit (#104631)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt 60% warning and 75% critical of V8’s effective heap limit as the default diagnostic timing for gateways configured with larger heaps?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but tests cannot decide whether delaying diagnostic events and stability evidence to these percentages is the intended operational availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept adaptive defaults after proof
options.body: Keep the proposed percentages and merge after live gateway evidence demonstrates both removal of the false positive and preserved pressure signaling.

options.title: Recalibrate the percentages
options.body: Ask the diagnostic owners to select different headroom or percentage criteria before the contributor provides final runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Accept adaptive defaults after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed percentages and merge after live gateway evidence demonstrates both removal of the false positive and preserved pressure signaling.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work added the critical stability-bundle lifecycle whose activation timing changes under this PR.
